'''Gunner mate''' was an enlisted [[Military rank/Legends|qualification]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]]. Skilled [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] [[Kesin Ommis/Legends|Kesin Ommis]] served as a gunner mate aboard the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Tharen]]'' prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].
